# ProfJero — Benjamin Amoako

> Benjamin Amoako (also known as ProfJero / Prof Jero) is a Full-Stack Developer & IT Trainer based in Cape Coast, Ghana with 5+ years of experience building websites, web applications, admin dashboards and business systems end-to-end (frontend, backend, databases, cloud). He is Co-Founder & Executive Director of Digital Bridge Initiative and Founder of ProfJero Hub.

## Blog

- [The Full-Stack Developer Roadmap for 2026: What to Learn, in What Order](https://profjero.pages.dev/blog/full-stack-developer-roadmap-2026): A practical, no-hype full-stack roadmap for 2026: the fundamentals that still matter, the tools worth learning, where AI fits, and how to build a portfolio that gets you hired.
- [Getting Found on Google and AI Assistants: SEO, Structured Data and llms.txt](https://profjero.pages.dev/blog/get-found-on-google-and-ai-assistants): How to make your website discoverable by both search engines and AI assistants in 2026: solid SEO foundations, JSON-LD structured data, generative engine optimization and llms.txt.
- [Using AI Coding Assistants Without Losing Your Fundamentals](https://profjero.pages.dev/blog/ai-coding-assistants-without-losing-fundamentals): AI coding assistants can make you faster or make you fragile. Here is how I use them day to day, and the habits that keep your own skills sharp while you do.
- [Building a Serverless Backend with Firebase Firestore (and Security Rules That Actually Protect You)](https://profjero.pages.dev/blog/serverless-backend-firebase-firestore-security-rules): A practical guide to building a serverless backend with Firebase: data modelling in Firestore, reading and writing from the web, and writing security rules that keep your data safe.
- [You're Not Late: A Letter to Every Beginner Who Feels Behind](https://profjero.pages.dev/blog/youre-not-late-for-beginners-who-feel-behind): If you feel too old, too slow or too far behind to start a career in tech, this is for you. Why comparison lies, what actually matters, and how to start from exactly where you are.
- [Core Web Vitals in Practice: A Developer's Guide to LCP, INP and CLS](https://profjero.pages.dev/blog/core-web-vitals-inp-performance-guide): A hands-on guide to Core Web Vitals: what LCP, INP and CLS measure, how to diagnose them, and practical fixes that make your site feel fast, especially on mid-range phones and slow networks.
- [Digital Skills, Real Opportunity: Why Young People in Ghana's Rural Communities Can't Be Left Behind](https://profjero.pages.dev/blog/digital-skills-opportunity-young-people-ghana): Talent is everywhere in Ghana, but access is not. Lessons from training young people in tech, what digital skills open up, and practical ways communities can close the gap.
- [Web App Security Essentials: A Practical Guide Based on the OWASP Top 10](https://profjero.pages.dev/blog/web-app-security-essentials-owasp-top-10): The security risks that matter most for web developers, explained with practical examples and fixes: access control, injection, authentication, misconfiguration, dependencies and more.
- [Consistency Over Talent: Lessons from 5 Years of Building Software](https://profjero.pages.dev/blog/consistency-over-talent-lessons-from-5-years-of-building): Five years of building software, training learners and starting organisations taught me one thing above all: consistency beats talent. Here are the lessons and habits that made the difference.

## FAQ

### What kind of projects do you build?

Websites, web applications, admin dashboards, e-learning platforms, inventory and point-of-sale systems, and APIs. I handle both the front end and the back end, so I can deliver a complete system.

### Which technologies do you use?

HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React on the front end; Node.js, PHP, Firebase/Firestore, MySQL and REST APIs on the back end; Cloudflare, Cloudinary and Google Cloud for hosting and media. I choose the stack that fits your budget and goals.

### How long does a project take?

A landing page usually takes 1–2 weeks. A business system with an admin dashboard typically takes 4–8 weeks depending on features. You get a clear timeline before we start.

### Can I try your systems before hiring you?

Yes. Most projects in my portfolio have live demos and video walkthroughs on YouTube or TikTok, so you can see exactly how they work.

### Do you work with clients outside Ghana?

Yes. I work remotely with clients anywhere and communicate via WhatsApp, email and video calls.

### Do you offer training?

Yes. I train individuals, schools and organisations in web development, digital skills and IT, both in person and online.
